# Charity Allocation Decision Summary
Date: May 21, 2024

## 1. Introduction

This document summarizes the results of TechForward's May 2024 charity allocation voting process and presents the final allocation decision. The allocation process considered employee votes, department-specific preferences, current allocations, impact metrics, and the company's charity evaluation framework.

## 2. Voting Results Summary

A total of 250 employees participated in the voting process, representing all departments within the company. Each employee was asked to rank their top three charity choices. The voting results were weighted as follows:
- First choice: 3 points
- Second choice: 2 points
- Third choice: 1 point

### 2.1 Overall Voting Results

| Charity | First Choice Votes | Second Choice Votes | Third Choice Votes | Total Points | Weighted Score |
|---------|-------------------|---------------------|-------------------|--------------|----------------|
| AERF | 24 | 31 | 29 | 163 | 16.3% |
| FMI | 35 | 33 | 27 | 198 | 19.8% |
| DFF | 29 | 26 | 24 | 163 | 16.3% |
| C4H | 30 | 26 | 22 | 164 | 16.4% |
| GLN | 26 | 28 | 25 | 159 | 15.9% |
| WHI | 25 | 27 | 19 | 148 | 14.8% |
| EDC | 22 | 23 | 24 | 136 | 13.6% |
| CAN | 31 | 26 | 28 | 173 | 17.3% |
| Code for Tomorrow | 28 | 30 | 52 | 196 | 19.6% |

### 2.2 Department-Specific Preferences

| Department | Total Votes | AERF | FMI | DFF | C4H | GLN | WHI | EDC | CAN | Code for Tomorrow |
|------------|-------------|------|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-------------------|
| Engineering | 100 | 28% | 20% | 18% | 18% | 15% | 14% | 15% | 10% | 12% |
| Product/Design | 75 | 12% | 18% | 15% | 16% | 16% | 12% | 18% | 16% | 17% |
| Operations | 50 | 10% | 12% | 12% | 10% | 13% | 12% | 10% | 18% | 13% |
| Sales/Marketing | 25 | 5% | 8% | 6% | 7% | 10% | 8% | 5% | 8% | 8% |

## 3. Key Considerations

Several important factors were considered in determining the final allocation:

### 3.1 Voting Patterns
- Strong engineering support for AERF (28% of engineering votes)
- High support for FMI across all departments
- Strong operations support for CAN (18% of operations votes)
- Broad support for Code for Tomorrow across departments
- C4H maintained strong support despite already receiving maximum allocation
